Portfolio.headline: Interfaces. APIs.
Portfolio.intro: I build applications with React, Next.js, and Node.js. Currently at Itaú Unibanco. Previously at Carrefour and Sam’s Club Brazil.
Portfolio.experienceIntro: Business workflows, interfaces, and integrations. Selected contributions built with product teams.
Portfolio.itauTitle: From native journeys to a WebView experience.
Portfolio.itauContext: Development and support for the tab bar hub in the Itaú app.
itauPoints: Rebuilt the frontend journey in WebView, previously maintained in Swift and Kotlin repositories.
Implemented local backend caching and contribute to the visual modernization of the experience.
Contribute to an internal specification-driven development tool with AI agents, skills, and MCP.
Portfolio.carrefourTitle: Member registration, from UI to endpoints.
Portfolio.carrefourContext: Interfaces and integrations for Carrefour and Sam’s Club Brazil.
carrefourPoints: Built the Sam’s Club member registration journey: UI, Node.js endpoints, and backend integration on VTEX.
Implemented automation for recurring payment processes.
Contributed to the maintenance and development of React interfaces and APIs.
Portfolio.talst: Application development and process automation with React, Node.js, NestJS, and Python.
Portfolio.projectsIntro: Independent projects to test ideas, build tools, and solve concrete problems.
Portfolio.aboutBody: I’m Giovanni Vicentin, a software engineer based in Brazil. I work across frontend and backend, focusing on accessible interfaces, integrations, and maintaining production applications.
